title: 视频剪辑 managed runtime environment
description: Environment selected by the actual DesireCore execution owner; a declaration grants no permission. Native assets are prepared separately from source material.

PORT.description: Actual owner-selected loopback port, 1 through65535, encoded as an environment string; MCP and UI reuse this same service.

APP_DATA_DIR.description: Canonical installation data root provided by DesireCore; takes precedence over standalone FABLECUT_DATA_DIR.

FABLECUT_MANAGED.description: MCP must reuse an existing verified service and may not start a detached UI server.

FABLECUT_EXPECTED_INSTANCE_ID.description: Exact service instanceId from actual current /api/desirecore/instance response. Mandatory together for managed MCP; never inferred from product UUID.

APP_DATA_ROOT.description: Compatibility owner-injected data root when APP_DATA_DIR is absent.

FABLECUT_DATA_DIR.description: Standalone explicit owned data root; owner-injected APP_DATA_DIR/APP_DATA_ROOT take precedence.

FABLECUT_CHROME.description: Set by the launcher to the verified app-owned pinned browser executable; never a developer machine default.

FABLECUT_EXPECTED_SCOPE_ID.description: Exact scopeId from the actual current installed runtime binding. Mandatory together for managed MCP; never inferred from product UUID.

FABLECUT_EXPECTED_RUNTIME_GENERATION.description: Exact runtimeGeneration from the actual current installed runtime binding. Mandatory together for managed MCP; never inferred from product UUID.

FABLECUT_EXPECTED_RELEASE_DIGEST.description: Exact releaseDigest from the current installed material/runtime binding; this is not an archive SHA. Mandatory together for managed MCP; never inferred from product UUID.
